extra.final_summary: Found and fixed data issues affecting the average body mass by species. First, normalized the 'sex' column by merging 'FEMALE' to 'female' (3 cells). Then, excluded 2 rows (ids 9, 48) with impossible negative flipper lengths (-185, -212 mm) and 2 rows (ids 43, 44) with impossible body masses (4.45M and 5.7M grams, likely extra zeros). After these fixes, calculated the average body mass per species on 63 valid rows: Adelie: 3687.5 g, Chinstrap: 3726.67 g, Gentoo: 5253.57 g.
